description: This file defines the GeographyType class and companion object, representing spatial geography data types with SRID and algorithm properties, including methods for construction, equality, and validation, within Apache Spark SQL module.

classes.name: GeographyType
classes.description: Represents a spatial geography data type with CRS, SRID, and algorithm properties, supporting equality, serialization, and validation.

classes.name: EdgeInterpolationAlgorithm
classes.description: Abstract class and companion object defining supported edge interpolation algorithms, currently only spherical.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Constructors for GeographyType with different parameter options (SRID, CRS string, algorithm).

methods.name: isSridSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given SRID is supported based on the spatial reference system mapper.

methods.name: toSrid
methods.description: Converts a CRS string to its corresponding SRID integer, handling special 'ANY' value.
